pixel_coords: x right, y down, origin top-left pixel, units px
view: top-down (nadir) aerial view of a winding two-lane asphalt road through grass and trees; two cars drive along the road from the top edge to the bottom edge

camera.evidence: median background vs car-free frames: mean abs diff 0.13 grey levels; frames 61-71 differ from each other by <0.05; no shift of road/kerb/trees
camera.perspective: nadir view, no visible perspective: one px scale applies to the whole ground plane (2D scene). Cars are rendered from straight above, their top-view outline is the world footprint.

silver_car.description: silver/white sports car with two red racing stripes over roof and bonnet; the FOLLOWING (rear) car; at frame 0 it is the left one of the two cars at the top edge
silver_car.partly_out_of_frame: frames 0-3 (top edge, 32% out at f0-1) and 56-60 (bottom edge, 84% out at f60); gone from frame 61
silver_car.size_uncertainty_px: length +-2, width +-2 (width includes the door mirrors only partly; with mirrors ~51-53)
silver_car.reference_point: centre of the top-view body outline (template centre corrected with stripe symmetry and outline edges on an average of 52 aligned crops)

dark_car.description: dark blue-black sports car (no stripes, amber headlights); the LEADING car; at frame 0 it is the right one of the two cars at the top edge, side by side with the silver car
dark_car.partly_out_of_frame: frames 0-2 (top edge, 30% out at f0-1) and 46-49 (bottom edge, 89% out at f49); gone from frame 50
dark_car.tree_occlusion: frames 31-35 (overhanging tree canopy covers part of its front/right side; up to ~20% by the green-pixel count, visually ~40% at frame 32)
dark_car.size_uncertainty_px: length +-4, width +-4 (dark body against dark road and shadow; measured on an average of 43 aligned crops)
dark_car.reference_point: centre of the top-view body outline (two templates reconciled, corrected with outline/headlight symmetry on the averaged crop)

per_frame_motion_summary_px.note: only to show track quality; answering sessions should compute from the track files
per_frame_motion_summary_px.silver_car_step_px_per_frame: 22.25 +-0.2 for every frame from 2 to 55 (0 between frames 0 and 1)
per_frame_motion_summary_px.dark_car_step_px_per_frame: 26.95 +-0.3 for every frame from 2 to 45 (0 between frames 0 and 1)
per_frame_motion_summary_px.centre_separation_px: 90.6 at f0, 113.8 at f10 (max early), 103.4 at f20 (min), then increasing to 198.8 at f45 and ~222 at f49

events.event: first frame; both cars at the top edge side by side (silver left/behind, dark right/ahead), partly out of frame
frame 1 is a duplicate of frame 0 (mean diff 0.02): both cars have not moved yet
start of motion: both cars jump straight to their full, constant per-frame step (instant start, no visible acceleration phase)
dark car fully inside the frame
silver car fully inside the frame
both cars round the right-hand bend at the top right; heading passes 90 deg (straight down) at about f18 for silver, f15 for dark
dark car starts passing under the overhanging tree canopy (until f35)
dark car starts leaving through the bottom edge
last frame with any part of the dark car visible
silver car starts leaving through the bottom edge
last frame with any part of the silver car visible; frames 61-71 show the empty road

road.description: two-lane asphalt road forming an S: enters at the top (x~350-700 at y=0), right-hand bend at top right (outer edge reaches x~867 at y~300), then runs down-left and leaves at the bottom (x~265-470 at y=1079)
road.width_px: ~180-196 between the white edge lines measured perpendicular to the road (approx., +-10)
road.markings: white solid edge lines on both sides; yellow dashed centre line
road.kerb: white/dark striped kerb just outside the right (outer) white line along the bend and down the right side

trees.description: clumps of trees on the right side of the road (top right, x 780-1080 y 0-280; right middle x 870-1080 y 390-660; lower right cluster x 585-870 y 665-890 that overhangs the road and covers the dark car in f31-35; bottom right x 540-1080 y 800-1080) and two at top left (x 0-280, y 0-200)

static_objects.grass_field: large dry-grass field left of the road (inside the bend) with darker patches/shadows
static_objects.background_image: scripts/bg.png (median of the car-free pixels, same 1080x1080 coordinates)

files.tracks/<car>.csv: frame,time_s,cx,cy (reference point px),heading_deg (direction of the car front, image angle: 0 = +x right, 90 = +y down),bbox_* (axis-aligned box of the rotated body rectangle, may extend outside the image),bbox_vis_* (clipped to the image),length_px,width_px (rigid body size),mask_len_px,mask_wid_px (per-frame background-difference mask extents, only where clean),visible_frac,partly_out_of_frame,occluded,match_score,method,reliability,frac_out_of_frame,frac_tree_occluded
files.scripts/: all measurement scripts and intermediate files
